# Synthetic detection measurements

<!-- Generated by DetectionPackTests. Do not hand-edit. -->

These measurements cover synthetic repositories only. Real-repository findings and owner triage remain unmeasured; these results do not establish production precision. No baselines, exceptions or disabled rules are applied.

The error-level gate is `20 × false positives <= true positives + false positives`, per rule and overall. Warning and note counts are separate. Recall includes only the currently authored rules; other planned rules remain outside this measurement.
